about_the_game:
In 1947, the secret agency NASS was founded to decode mysterious cosmic signals, triggering Japan’s rapid technological boom.

However, in 1986, the ignition of a zero-point energy reactor ripped open a gateway to another dimension, inviting alien life to Earth and plunging the planet into a desperate battle for survival.

Amid survivors, Haru allies with Yoshida, a former NASS scientist, and together they navigate a world forever altered, with the hope of saving Earth and those trapped in singularity anomalies.

GRAVITY & TIME-BENDING TECHNOLOGY

Harness a singularity reactor to bend gravity and warp time itself. Use these powers tactically to manipulate the battlefield and disarm enemies with brutal efficiency, executing them in inventive and satisfying ways.
‎ ‎

UNIQUE TACTICAL COMBAT

In a post-apocalyptic world where weapons are scarce, survival means improvisation. Turn enemy strength into their weakness. Redirect attacks, lure them into dangerous crossfire, and exploit every opening.
‎ ‎

RANGE OF ENEMIES

Face a wide range of enemies, each with distinct AI behavior, combat patterns, and unique weaknesses.
‎ ‎

INTENSE BOSS BATTLES

Clash with bosses that mirror your own abilities. Outsmart them, turn their strengths against them, and manipulate the chaos of the battlefield by using lesser enemies as your weapons.
‎ ‎

UNIQUE ATMOSPHERE

Experience a hand-painted, post-apocalyptic world brought to life through a cinematic 2D/3D hybrid style. Traverse ruined cities, overrun hospitals, underground NASS labs, and warped anomalies where past and future collide. Each level offers new traversal challenges and hidden lore.
‎ ‎

‎IMMERSIVE NARRATIVE

Discover the overlapping stories of survivors and those trapped within singularity anomalies. Through scattered diaries, lost recordings, and fragmented memories, guide Haru on a journey to uncover the hidden truth.

SOUNDTRACK

A carefully composed, cinematic score brings the post-apocalyptic world to life, deepening the emotional impact of every encounter and discovery.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent combat sequences with various levels of gore, including the decapitation of limbs and heads. The narrative features dark themes, moral ambiguity, and emotionally intense moments.

short_description: KNIGHTS OF THE FALL is a sci-fi 2D/3D hybrid platformer that tells the story of Haru, a combat veteran, and Yoshida, his scientist sidekick, who join forces to uncover how interdimensional travel and the afterlife could be connected, using time and gravity-bending technology.
